title: Tencent Hunyuan Launches Tencent Hy Translation App: Supports Inter-Translation of 33 Languages, Covering 5 Ethnic Languages

content_html:
September 24th news, Tencent Hunyuan announced today that the "Tencent Hy Translation" app is officially launched and also supports mini programs, plugins, and PC experience. You can directly search for "Tencent Hunyuan Translation" to use it. The product is built based on the Tencent Hunyuan Hy-MT2 translation model, supporting mutual translation of 33 languages, covering five Chinese minority languages and dialects, and offering various methods such as voice translation, photo translation, and offline translation.

Offline available, covering Hong Kong, Macau, Taiwan, and Southeast Asia

According to the introduction, in the offline translation mode, users can download the translation model to their phone in advance, allowing stable use even without internet or poor signal. The app is now available in 12 countries and regions, including the United States, Japan, South Korea, Singapore, Malaysia, Thailand, Vietnam, Myanmar, and the Chinese Hong Kong, Macau, and Taiwan regions, showing Tencent's strategy in cross-border and multilingual scenarios.

The Hy-MT2 translation model was open-sourced in May this year

Public information shows that the Tencent Hunyuan translation model Hy-MT2 was open-sourced in May this year, supporting mutual translation of 33 languages and five minority languages/dialects. Its performance in multi-language instruction following, professional field translation, and real scenario translation has significantly improved compared to the previous generation Hy-MT1.5. The launch of the "Tencent Hy Translation" app directly brings this open-source model's capabilities to end users.
